name: Save PDF as
description: Save the current PDF editing session to an authorized new PDF path without overwriting the source file.

sessionId.description: Stable local editing or browser session ID returned by an inspect/create tool.

expectedRevision.description: Expected revision used for optimistic concurrency control. Copy this value from the latest RealmFlow UI/API state; do not invent it.

outputPath.description: Authorized new output path as a relative path under the authorized root; it must not overwrite existing content. Do not invent or pass absolute local paths.

expectedAbsent.description: Must be true to confirm the target path does not already exist.

requireRenderSmokeTest.description: Whether RealmFlow must render the first generated PDF page locally before accepting the file.

scopeRoot.description: Optional authorized root override. Omit or pass "." to use the current authorized root.
